chapter.verse: Tua hi-in sanggamte aw, note' kiangah kong pai lai-in thugen siamna leh pilna tawh Pasian' thusim hong pulak ka hikei hi.
A hang pen note' lakah Jesu Khris leh a kikhailum mipa' thu losiah theih dang bangmah a neilo dingin ka khensatsa ahi hi.
Tua mah bangin thanemna, launa leh linna tampi tawh note' kiangah kong om a,
ka thugen leh ka thuhilhte zong a lunglut-huai pilna kamte kihel lo-in Kha leh vangliatna a lakkhia bek ka hi hi.
Tua pen na upna uh mihingte' pilna tungah kinga lo-in Pasian' vangliatna tungah a kingakh nading ahi hi.
Thukhat ah, a khangcing mite' tungah pilna thu ka gen uh a, tua pen a maimang dinga kikoih tu-a khanghun pilna ahihkeileh tu-a khanghun uliante' pilna nam hilo hi.
Kote' gen ahihleh khanghunte a kipat ma, eite' vangliat thupit nadinga Pasian' sehkholhsa, a ki-imcip a kiseelsim Pasian' pilna thu ahi hi.
Hih khanghun uliante lakah hih thu a tel kuamah om lo uh a, tel uh hileh minphatna Topa khailum lo ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin lai kigelh a om mah bangin, “Mittang' muh ngeiloh, bil' zak ngeiloh, mihing' lungsim' geel ngeinailoh thute, amah a it mite' adinga Pasian' bawlkholhsak ahi hi.”
Hih thute Pasian in Kha tungtawnin kote hong lak khin hi. A hang pen Kha in Pasian' thuthukte dongin na khempeuh zongkhia ahih man hi.
A hang pen mi khat tawh kisai thute, a sunga om ama' kha simloh, kua in thei ahi hiam? Tua dan mahin Pasian tawh kisai thute Pasian' Kha simloh kuamah in thei lo hi.
Tu-in kote in a khawnkhonga Pasian' hong piak thute ka theihtel theih nadingun leitung kha ahilo, Pasian' kiangpana Kha ka ngah khin uh hi.
Hih thute mihing pilna tawh ahilo, Kha' hong hilh thute tawh kong hawmsawn uh a, Kha Siangtho nei mite tungah kha tawh kisai thumaan thutakte kong genkhia uh hi.
Cilesa mihing in Pasian' Kha tawh kisai thute sang lo uh hi. A hang pen tuate ama' adingin a haihuai thu hi a, tua thute pen kha tawh a kisittel nam ahih manin cilesa in tel zolo hi.
Kha Siangtho a nei mi in na khempeuh khen thei a, ahi zongin amah a khen thei kuamah om lo hi.
“A hang pen amah thu a genpih dingin kua in Topa' lungsim thei ahi hiam?” Kote ka hih uhleh Khris lungsim ka nei uh hi.
